notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed invisible points
Changed 10K achievement to 20K
Fixed 20K and 50K achievements

notes.title: Challenges Update
notes.notes:
Revamped the puzzle progression for a smoother and more accessible experience.
Separated the open-ended puzzles into the challenge category, allowing players to tackle them in any order. Completing all challenges may unlock a secret.
Introduced a first-launch tutorial to guide new players.
Removed the Fire color palette.
Fixed various bugs for a more stable gameplay experience.
